name: sigma-3-0-finality-astro
description: СИГМА 3.0 FINALITY — Национална криминалистична платформа за обществени поръчки и съдебно-институционално разузнаване (Astro + Dart Sass @use + TypeScript)

scripts.sync:docs: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['index.html','razsledvaniya.html','razsledvaniq.html','telk-skener.html','ezdrave-telk.html','sadeben-odit.html','ot-mrak-kam-svetlina.html','en.html']) { if (fs.existsSync('dist/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f,'docs/'+f); } if (fs.existsSync('dist/en.html')) { fs.mkdirSync('docs/en',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/en.html','docs/en/index.html'); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:sass && npm run build:astro && npm run sync:docs
